title: CTFCarryComponentSignatures
description:
CTFCarryComponentSignatures is a transformer specification to copy the
signature referrers (e.g. cosign signatures and attestations) of a
normalized-layout component version from a source repository into a CTF
repository that already holds the same component version.

ocm.software.open-component-model.bindin.title: Repository
ocm.software.open-component-model.bindin.description:
Repository is a type that represents an OCI repository backed by a CTF archive.
This archive is accessed as if it was a remote OCI repository, but all accesses to it
are translated into archive-specific operations.

Note that content stored within this Repository is not necessarily globally accessible so
the OCI library does not attempt to interpret global accesses.

accessMode.description:
AccessMode can be set to request readonly access or creation
The format of the path is determined by the access mode bitmask aggregated with |.
If not specified, the AccessMode will be interpreted as AccessModeReadOnly for read-based operations
and as AccessModeReadWrite for write-based operations.

componentVersionLayout.description:
ComponentVersionLayout selects the storage layout used when adding component versions
to this repository. Empty keeps the layout of an already stored version and defaults to
"v2" (the access-bearing descriptor manifest as the tag target); "normalized" stores a
stable, access-free descriptor manifest as the tag target that cosign can sign.

filePath.description:
Path is the path of the CTF Archive on the filesystem.

Examples
- ./relative/path/to/archive.tgz
- relative/path/to/archive.tar
- /absolute/path/to/archive-folder
